opportunities.name: Center strike ambush
opportunities.objective: Test center strike ambush against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Watch Out! Eep!'s center triples its magic damage, making R sleep a setup for a precise W and Rocketbelt approach. Lich Bane rewards one post-cast attack while Shadowflame improves low-health magic/true packets; Q edge true damage remains a separate component.
opportunities.requiredState: Sleep lands and allies do not wake the target before centered W.
opportunities.failure: Premature wake or displacement loses the triple center hit.
opportunities.test: Compare centered versus edge W and track the single wake bonus.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Sleep does not multiply every subsequent hit, and magic penetration cannot amplify Q edge true damage.

opportunities.objective: Test dust resistance runner against conventional damage at equal gold.
opportunities.mechanic: Dream Dust and repeated Blooming Blows magic hits sustain Liandry and Bloodletter pressure; Cosmic Drive stacks with Lillia's ability-hit movement pattern. Visage supports documented kit healing only after confirming its passive source, while Abyssal rewards staying close for repeated Q rotations.
opportunities.requiredState: Keep Prance stacks and cycle Q outer edges around a melee target.
opportunities.failure: Hard CC stops the movement pattern; extra defenses reduce sleep burst.
opportunities.test: Compare Q cycles, damage and healing over twelve seconds against a moving foe.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A long-range E hit does not keep enemies permanently inside close-range Abyssal aura.

ruledOut.reason: Sleep does not multiply every subsequent hit, and magic penetration cannot amplify Q edge true damage.

unknowns: Controlled current-patch proc testing remains necessary; source helper/statFormula expressions are evidence, not confirmed runtime behavior.

testPlan: Required state: Sleep lands and allies do not wake the target before centered W.
Compare centered versus edge W and track the single wake bonus.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Premature wake or displacement loses the triple center hit.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Sleep does not multiply every subsequent hit, and magic penetration cannot amplify Q edge true damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Hextech Rocketbelt, Lich Bane, Rabadon's Deathcap, Shadowflame, Void Staff, Sorcerer's Shoes. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Lillia causes all enemy champions with Dream Dust to become Drowsy for [1.5] seconds. Afterward, they fall Asleep for [2.5 / 2.75 / 3] seconds.

When awakened by damage, they take an additional [100 / 150 / 200 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Lillia lobs a swirlseed overhead, dealing [60 / 85 / 110 / 135 / 160 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage where it lands and revealing and Slowing them by [40]% for [3] seconds. If no enemies are hit, the seed rolls until it hits an enemy or collides with terrain.

Passive: Lillia's Ability hits grant [0.03 / 0.04 / 0.05 / 0.06 / 0.07 + (0.0003) × AP] Move Speed for [6.5] seconds, stacking up to [4] times.

Active: Lillia whirls her censer, dealing [35 / 45 / 55 / 65 / 75 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage, plus an additional [35 / 45 / 55 / 65 / 75 + (0.35) × AP] true damage at the outer edge.
Lillia winds up a huge strike, dealing [80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage. Enemies in the center take [(80 / 100 / 120 / 140 / 160 + (0.35) × AP) × (3)] damage instead.
